name: Discrete Transistor — Phototransistor
description: Discrete phototransistor cluster with SMD and radial footprint options, featuring tier B parts from digikey-kicad-library including LTR-301 and TEMT6000X01.
selection_hints: Select based on required mounting style such as SMD or radial footprint options.
Match package land pattern to Phototransistor_SMD_4x2mm_TEMT6000X01 or Phototransistor_4.4x1.5mm_P2.54_Radial.
Choose between representative parts LTR-301 and TEMT6000X01 based on footprint compatibility.
avoid_when: Components other than discrete phototransistors are required.
The PCB layout requires package footprints outside the available SMD or radial phototransistor options.
Quality tier ratings higher than tier B are strictly required.
